officialSources.officialDescriptionSummary: Official HÖ15 sources describe a 23.9 km medium-difficulty section from Vikskvarn to Lövhult. The route starts at Vikskvarn's mill ruins and Almesåkraformationen geology, continues through Västra Bråna, Spexhultasjön, Torsa stenar/Drakaröret and Huluberget, then finishes at Lövhult friluftsområde near Nässjö. Lövhult is described as a major outdoor hub with exercise loops, sledding hill, riding hall, accessible asphalt loop, camping and hostel open year-round.
officialSources.appDetailTextDraft: HÖ15 is a long forest-and-highland stage from the three-way Vikskvarn junction to Lövhult friluftsområde. It combines geology and mill remains at Vikskvarn, open agricultural landscape at Västra Bråna, lake and water-protection context at Spexhultasjön, cultural history at Torsa stenar and Drakaröret, and a high viewpoint/rest stop at Huluberget. The Lövhult end has the strongest services on the section, including official water, camping, toilets, showers, parking, cafe/service and public-transport access via JLT line 320/Nässjö. Fixed-route transit at Vikskvarn is weak, so plan taxi, bike or pickup for that end. Recheck route notices, Lövhult storm-damage notices and fire status before user-facing publication.

commuteAccess.summary: HÖ15 has weak public transport at Vikskvarn and comparatively strong public transport at Lövhult. Vikskvarn is best handled by car, bike, taxi or prearranged pickup to the reserve parking. Lövhult is reachable from Nässjö by bus 320 to the Lövhult/Nässjö Lövhult stop plus about 1 km walking, or from Nässjö C by taxi, bike or longer walk.

start.name: Bodafors station
start.caveats: Slightly farther than Grimstorp by straight-line but the better practical transit hub because it has rail service. Still not close enough for normal endpoint access unless combined with bike, taxi or pickup.

fireRules: Länsstyrelsernas fire-ban service returned no fire ban for Nässjö at query time on 2026-04-29, but this must not be encoded statically.
MSB Brandrisk Ute reported elevated fire risk on 2026-04-29/2026-04-30 and forecast risk rising around 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-02. Recheck day-of-use.
Use established fireplaces only when permitted, avoid fire on moss/peat/bare rock, do not take dead wood in protected areas and follow local signage.
If detouring to Bäckafall, fire is allowed only with brought wood according to the rules lane.

protectedAreas.visitorRulesSummary: In Vikskvarn/Eketorp and Lövhult, do not damage natural objects or dead wood, collect mosses/lichens/wood fungi where prohibited, dig plants, set up permanent caravan/motorhome/camper/trailer or put up signs. Organized camp activity with more than 30 participants needs Länsstyrelsen permission in Vikskvarn/Eketorp. Spexhultasjön water-protection context means visitors should avoid pollution, washing and fuel/chemical handling near water. Bäckafall and Fallamosse rules are nearby/detour context unless future GIS changes the route scope.
protectedAreas.caveats: Reserve/current-news pages showed no relevant current news where checked on 2026-04-29, but this is dynamic. Apply protected-area rules only to matching route segments, not the whole Höglandsleden.

dogsAndLivestock: 2026-04-29 is inside the 1 March-20 August period when dogs must be kept under especially strict control around wildlife; leash is conservative guidance.
Keep dogs leashed and under control in reserve areas, near grazing animals and where local signs require it.
Bäckafall loop sources mention cattle/electric fence May-Sep; this is detour/nearby context unless the route scope changes.
rulesAndSafety.huntingForestry: No HÖ15-specific hunting or forestry closure was found. Hunting and forestry operations may be locally signed and not centrally published; respect signs and avoid disturbing hunts.
rulesAndSafety.waterSafety: Lövhult is the strongest HÖ15-relevant official water source. Vikskvarn water is ambiguous, Fällhemmet is off HÖ15, and lake/bog/stream water should not be treated as potable. Spexhultasjön lies in a water-protection area, so avoid pollution and do not wash or handle fuel/chemicals near water.
